context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-02. A merge of teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 7.242 parameters. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2024-03-02. CAVEAT: the base here is teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B, but the card's own merge YAML shows mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 as the DARE-TIES merge base, with OpenHermes, Noromaid-7B-0.4-DPO, WestLake-7B-v2-laser and neural-chat-7b-v3-3 as weighted contributors (density 0.55, int8_mask). So 'beats the base' is true of ONE contributor, not of the merge root - and the card's own table shows the merge (68.86 avg) losing to another contributor, cognitivecomputations/WestLake-7B-v2-laser, at 74.78, and to Intel/neural-chat-7b-v3-3 at 69.83. It wins AI2 (66.72 vs 64.93), HellaSwag, MMLU, Winogrande and GSM8k, and loses TruthfulQA (51.50 vs 52.24) - read the rows, not the average. The GSM8k margin (65.20 vs 26.08) inflates the average because the OpenHermes base was never tuned on math; that is a floor, not a capability gap. Licence is cc-by-nc-4.0 and the card is tagged not-for-all-audiences: this is not a commercially usable checkpoint. Leaderboard is the retired Open LLM Leaderboard v1 harness. FLOPs per active token taken from the base record (2 * active_params_b * 1e9, SCHEMA.md:543) instead of the generator's 6e9 coefficient at tools/mk_finetune_record.py:251. ADDED 2026-11-02 (img batch, figure read): the card's two figures are a radar chart with NO printed point values and a decorative robot-portrait illustration, so the figures contributed zero rows. The rows added this tick come from the card's own text tables, which the record had read only partially: MT-Bench 7.171875, EQ-Bench v2.1 65.56, and - the material one - TruthfulQA 51.50, which the notes already cited as the single harness loss versus the base but which had never been entered as a row.
